title: TTS content-addressed cache
summary: Caches synthesized speech under SHA-256 keys of engine, model, voice, speed and exact text, with atomic writes so crashed renders never leave reusable half files.

side_effects: creates cache directories and WAV files under the given root

review.notes: Unit tests pass with pytest on Python 3.13 (numpy, Pillow); ffmpeg integration tests ran with ffmpeg present.
